The [[ma'oste]] and [[the Book]] disagree as to which meaning is assigned to ''ta'u'' as opposed to ''ta'unai''. The book wins, and
* ''ta'u'' means ''expanding a tanru''
* ''ta'unai'' means ''making a tanru''
